business_summary: Shanghai Guao Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, marketing, and servicing of integrated smart financial system solutions and financial software information products in China and internationally. The company offers financial equipment, such as Banknote counting machine/banknote sorting machine/bundling series, signature card intelligent management system, smart filing cabinet, smart counter, and dual-screen POS device; financial derivatives software, including QWIN options strategy trading software, QWIN futures and options market making software, and other related products and services; and other related services. It also engages in robot research and development; involves trading activity; manufactures computers, communications, and other electronic equipment; offers software and information technology services; other professional consultation and investigation services; and designs integrated circuit chips. The company serves banks, securities companies, futures companies, public funds, private funds, and other financial institutions. The company formerly known as Shanghai Gu'ao Electronic Machinery Co., Ltd. Shanghai Guao Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Shanghai, China.
